description: This file defines the ReturnStatus model class for the OpenCart admin localization module, providing methods to manage return status records in the database, including CRUD operations, cache management, and description handling.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: Model class for managing return status data within the OpenCart admin localization system, including methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving return statuses and their descriptions.

methods.name: addReturnStatus
methods.description: Creates a new return status record in the database for multiple languages and returns the new return status ID.

methods.name: editReturnStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing return status by deleting current descriptions and adding new ones for all associated languages.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatus
methods.description: Deletes a return status record from the database by its primary key.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return statuses associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getReturnStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a return status record based on its ID for the current language.

methods.name: getReturnStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return status records, optionally filtered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalReturnStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of return status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Creates a description entry for a return status in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for return statuses in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description record for a specific return status in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific return status.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return status descriptions in a specific language.
